svg.title: NosoGraph evidence pipeline
svg.desc: Conceptual diagram of NosoGraph’s evidence chain: source families enter 25 registered adapters, are normalised and validated into typed claims, carry one of four evidence states, keep a provenance snapshot, and are exposed through the CLI, API and exports.
